description: Annex III - Utility and governmental services - WaterNetwork Appurtenance - Water Storage Point - BD-L-TC - water reservoirs (point) from the official carto-/topographic database is a dataset listed in Geoportal of the Grand-Duchy of Luxembourg, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by catalog.inspire.geoportail.lu. BD-L-TC - water reservoirs (point) from the official carto-/topographic database. The BD-L-TC is a vector dataset at the scale 1:5000 which represents the earth surface's objects on the national territory, with attributes in german, french and english. Data transformed into INSPIRE data model. Coverage: LU. Its keywords include INSPIRE. The listing shows 4 download or service links in ATOM, OGCFEAT, GML, WMS. The listing shows 2026-06-12 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Creative Commons CC0 1.0 Universal. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support water network and flood-defence studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-geoportal-lu.
